verdict.rationale: YYLO integrations pull GitHub issues into its kanban ledger and return completed responses to the source thread, and ledger tasks can then be started with a subagent via task start or yylo init, supporting the flow of turning an issue into an agent task. Missing for 10: a single documented command that directly converts one specific issue into an agent task in one step, and hands-on confirmation the GitHub-issue import works end-to-end.
